posts.title: Liquid Gold
posts.description: You poured for him a bowl of liquid gold Rich with life, and stories untold It bubbled to the rim, a meniscus it formed Of course with growth, uncertainty adorned. The trickle was gentle, small enough to stop. Small enough to account for every drop. It rolled off of the table and you respond Your hands, cupped together, embracing bond. posts.title: Swan and Mallard
posts.description: I found a fake restaurant called the swan and mallard , and found the concept immensely beautiful. I appreciate the metaphor of darkness and light, and I also appreciate thoughtful design that creates identity with empty space. I made my own variant, and a small poem to accompany it that reflects the sentiment it gives me. Swan and Mallard Swan and mallard, an unlikely pair One a shadow, one light
